label: ESTIMATE / ASSUMPTION: OSM-derived land-cover classes mapped to literature parameters. Not calibrated and not validated for Barcelona.
assumptions: A1: Pervious-soil texture is clay_loam everywhere. SoilGrids v2 (0-5 cm) at 2.105E 41.420N (Collserola) gives clay 28.9%, sand 31.2%, silt 39.8%, which is USDA clay loam. SoilGrids returns null at the 3 urban points tested, so the Collserola texture is extrapolated to urban parks. Raw files are in manifests/raw/g3/landcover/soilgrids_*.json.

A2: 'sealed' classes get Ks=0 and no Green-Ampt soil. This structural assumption (no infiltration through roofs, roads, pavements or water) is not a value from the Rawls table; psi and porosity are NoData there.
A3: TR-55 'smooth surfaces' n=0.011 is used for every sealed surface and for water. Water is not in TR-55; this is an ASSUMPTION.
A4: OSM lines are buffered by an assumed half-width per highway class (road_half_width_m). This is not measured.
A5: Cells inside the boundary with no OSM land-cover tag default to urban_sealed (dense city fabric: courtyards, plazas, pavements, port).
A6: leisure=park/garden is treated as grass, although many Barcelona parks are partly paved. Pitches/playgrounds are treated as sealed (artificial turf and paving are common).
A7: tunnel=yes and covered=yes ways are skipped. Layer order (later overwrites earlier) is given by 'order'.

classes.name: path_unpaved
classes.osm: highway in unpaved_highway or surface in unpaved_surface_values, buffered
